navigation.topbarSummary: Clean desk shell with faster scanability for live market surfaces.

mySymbols.title: My Symbols
mySymbols.heroCopy: Keep core favorites pinned at the top and open the full tracked quote list without jumping back into the dashboard panel.
mySymbols.noFavoritesCopy: Use the search page to pin core favorites that should stay at the top of My Symbols.
mySymbols.limitedCoverageBody: Outside equity detail coverage. Keep managing it here instead of opening the full symbol detail.
mySymbols.favoriteRemoveBlocked: Favorite remove blocked until tracked symbols refresh succeeds.
mySymbols.favoriteRemoveFailed: Favorite remove failed. Check trading-core connectivity.
mySymbols.noTrackedSymbolsCopy: Tracked quotes will appear here once the scanner is following at least one symbol.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.heroCopy: Read-only account state from the aggregate portfolio summary, with returned sections kept visible while configuration, upstream, stale sync, partial data, and empty-account states are labeled separately.
portfolio.loadingPortfolio: Loading the aggregate portfolio summary from trading-core...
portfolio.endpointPendingBody: The portfolio page is wired to the BFF, but the aggregate summary is not available yet.
portfolio.invalidResponseBody: The aggregate route responded, but the payload did not match the portfolio summary contract.
portfolio.notConfiguredBody: The portfolio BFF is reachable, but server-only trading-core configuration or credentials are missing.
portfolio.upstreamUnavailableBody: The portfolio BFF could not read the upstream aggregate summary. Returned cache is not treated as a live portfolio.
portfolio.staleSyncBody: The aggregate summary is connected, but trading-core marked the latest account sync as stale.
portfolio.partialDataBody: The aggregate summary is connected, but trading-core marked at least one portfolio section as partial or degraded.
portfolio.connectedEmptyBody: The aggregate summary is connected and returned no current holdings for the configured account scope.
portfolio.summaryUnavailableBody: The aggregate portfolio summary route is not returning a usable response.
portfolio.summaryDegradedBody: The aggregate summary is connected, but trading-core marked the portfolio sync as stale, partial, or degraded.

risk.title: Portfolio risk snapshot
risk.topExposuresLabel: Top holdings and exposures by allocation or notional
risk.loadingBody: Loading the execution runtime portfolio risk snapshot...
risk.endpointPendingBody: The portfolio page is wired to the BFF, but the runtime risk snapshot is not available yet.
risk.invalidResponseBody: The runtime route responded, but the payload did not match the portfolio risk snapshot contract.
risk.notConfiguredBody: The runtime risk BFF is reachable, but server-only trading-core configuration or credentials are missing.
risk.upstreamUnavailableBody: The risk snapshot BFF could not read the upstream runtime snapshot. The rest of the portfolio page remains usable.
risk.unavailableBody: Execution runtime did not return usable portfolio risk data. This section stays read-only and does not infer missing live account risk.
risk.staleBody: Execution runtime returned a stale risk snapshot. Values are shown only as last reported data.
risk.partialBody: Execution runtime returned partial risk data. Returned rows stay visible while missing fields are labeled.
risk.emptyExposuresBody: The risk snapshot did not include top holdings, top exposures, or concentration rows.
risk.emptyOrdersTitle: No open order exposure rows reported.
risk.emptyOrdersBody: The risk snapshot did not include open orders or top open-order notional rows.
risk.noConcentrationWarningsBody: Execution runtime did not return concentration threshold warnings for this snapshot.
risk.noStaleWarningsBody: Execution runtime did not return stale position or stale order warning rows.

errors.endpointPending: Runtime portfolio risk snapshot endpoint is not available yet.
errors.configMissing: Trading upstream configuration is missing for the risk snapshot.
errors.upstreamUnavailable: Trading-core portfolio risk upstream is unavailable.
errors.emptyResponse: Portfolio risk snapshot returned an empty response.

weekPnl.label: Weekly P/L
weekPnl.detail: Total asset change over the last 7 days

portfolio.emptyAccountsBody: The aggregate summary is connected, but it returned no account rows for the current portfolio scope.
portfolio.emptyHoldingsBody: The aggregate summary is connected and returned no holdings for the current accounts.
portfolio.emptyAllocationBody: The aggregate summary is connected but did not include allocation rows or holding allocation percentages.
portfolio.emptyActivityTitle: No order or execution summary yet.
portfolio.emptyActivityBody: The aggregate summary is connected but did not include recent orders or fills. This page remains read-only.
portfolio.partialAccountsBody: Trading-core returned account rows, but one or more balances or account summaries are missing. Returned cards remain visible.
portfolio.partialHoldingsBody: Trading-core did not return a complete holdings array for every account. Returned holdings remain visible.
portfolio.partialAllocationBody: Trading-core marked the summary as partial, and no complete allocation rows were returned.
portfolio.partialActivityBody: Trading-core marked the summary as partial, and no recent order or execution rows were returned.

errors.endpointPending: Aggregate portfolio summary endpoint is not available yet.
errors.emptyResponse: Portfolio summary returned an empty response.

signalReview.title: Signal Review Calendar
signalReview.heroCopy: Browse stored signal-decider dates, select a decision day, and inspect replay-style outcomes per symbol from the feedback rows trading-core has already stored.

actions.openStoredFeedbackUpTo: Open up to {count} rows in feedback table

states.emptyMonth: Month scan completed: no stored decisions were found.
states.emptySelected: No signal-decider decisions are stored for the selected date.
states.feedbackTableUnavailable: The selected date cannot open feedback rows right now. Retry calendar reads; another unavailable date is not expected to work without stored evidence.
states.feedbackNavigationFailed: The feedback table did not open. Check the connection and retry this action.
states.monthReadPartial: Some dates could not be read, so the month decision count is incomplete. Retry calendar reads for the failed dates; confirmed empty dates remain distinguishable from unavailable dates.
states.monthReadUnavailable: The month read failed, so its decision count is unavailable. Retry calendar reads for this month and the selected date; unavailable dates stay disabled until a read succeeds.
states.openDashboardFeedback: Calendar reads are unavailable, so this opens the feedback date last identified by Dashboard: {marketDate}.
states.openLatestFeedback: Selected-date reviews are unavailable, so this opens the latest known usable feedback date: {marketDate}.
states.progressUnavailable: Role progress is unavailable for this date, so completion state is based on stored rows only.
states.replayVerdictUnavailable: Replay verdict is not stored yet. Use the signal rationale separately from pending review fields.
states.replayWindowProvisional: The requested {days}-day replay window is not fully observed yet, so the review remains provisional.
states.replayUnavailable: Replay horizon results are not stored for this symbol yet.
states.riskContextUnavailable: No operator-facing risk context is stored for this signal.
states.selectedUnavailable: The selected-date read failed. This does not confirm that no decisions are stored. Retry calendar reads instead of selecting another unavailable date.
states.selectedInlineUnavailableStored: The inline review summary is unavailable, but {count} stored feedback rows are available in the feedback table.
states.signalRationaleUnavailable: Signal rationale is not stored for this decision.

signalDeciderFeedback.heroCopy: Decision-support results from the stored signal-decider feedback rows. This view does not create orders.
signalDeciderFeedback.shortTermHeroCopy: Decision-support results from stored short-term decider feedback rows, including tactical trigger plans and short-term risk/data-gap context. This view does not create orders.

calendarContext.label: Calendar feedback context
calendarContext.fallbackBreadcrumb: Calendar / selected date {originDate} / feedback data date {marketDate}

review.pendingMessage: Verdict and realized outcome are not present in the stored feedback payload yet.
review.replayReviewPendingWindow: Replay review is pending for the {days}-day window.
review.replayWindowNotMature: The {days}-day replay window is not mature yet.
review.replayWindowProvisional: The requested {days}-day replay window is not fully observed yet, so the review remains provisional.
review.resultEmpty: Outcome details recorded without additional notes.
review.noRealizedOutcome: Realized outcome is not present in this row yet.

comparison.title: Cross-decider comparison
comparison.empty: No matching opposite-decider output is stored for this symbol/date while viewing {agentLabel}.
comparison.unavailable: Comparison is unavailable because the opposite-decider feedback read failed or has not returned.

dataGaps.title: Decider Data Gaps
dataGaps.description: Aggregates recurring missing-context complaints from stored decider feedback rows for the selected market date and agent.

empty.noFeedback: No feedback rows are available for this date and agent, so data-gap aggregation cannot run.
empty.noDataGaps: Feedback rows are available, but no data-gap flags or missing-context reasons were detected.
empty.noFilteredGaps: No data gaps match the selected category and symbol filters.

evaluation.title: 5-day evaluation
evaluation.notComputedMessage: The 5-day window appears mature, but no evaluation row is stored. Rerun the evaluation stage.
evaluation.pendingWindowMessage: Needs {days} more trading days before 5-day outcome can be computed.
evaluation.pendingWindowMessageUnknown: The 5-day outcome is pending until the forward trading-day window matures.
evaluation.insufficientDataMessage: Price bars required for the 5-day window are missing. Review the data quality warnings for specific bars.
evaluation.unknownMessage: The evaluation status is not recognized yet. Check the stored status metadata.

summary.noDataMarketDateUnavailable: No {agentLabel} rows are stored for the selected market date.
summary.stateRunning: {agentLabel} is still running for {dateLabel}, so stored rows are not ready yet.
summary.statePartial: {agentLabel} feedback for {dateLabel} is available, but no rows matched the current filters.
summary.stateNeedsReview: {agentLabel} rows for {dateLabel} require review-state completion before they can render here.
summary.stateWaiting: No {agentLabel} feedback rows were returned for {dateLabel}.

errors.feedbackReadTimeout: {agentLabel} feedback read timed out. Retry this market date; this is a temporary Core read issue, not confirmed no-feedback.
errors.dataGapReadTimeout: Data-gap aggregation is unavailable because {agentLabel} feedback timed out. Retry this market date before treating it as no-feedback.

markets.title: Markets
markets.description: Market breadth and flow are not a standalone live feed yet. This screen keeps the route usable with explicit source status, factor screening, and links back to wired market context.
markets.cryptoStateTitle: Read-only crypto surfaces are gated on Core and exec data
markets.cryptoHeroCopy: This route shows crypto market and runtime readiness only when trading-core or exec exposes confirmed read models. It does not call Upbit from the browser and does not expose order controls.
markets.cryptoOverviewCopy: Review crypto market and runtime readiness without changing the existing KRX/KIS market flow.
markets.cryptoEndpointStateCopy: Missing or unconfigured crypto endpoints stay visible as pending or unavailable instead of rendering placeholder market values.
markets.cryptoRuntimeRowsCopy: Rows appear only from upstream crypto read models and may include venue, quote currency, market-data state, strategy context, and paper readiness.
markets.cryptoStrategyPaperCopy: BTC/ETH strategy context and Upbit paper runtime state render only after core or exec returns read models. Missing data stays pending and this page still exposes no order controls.
markets.cryptoNoStrategyPaperRows: No crypto strategy or paper runtime rows are available.
markets.cryptoNoStrategyPaperRowsCopy: Core or exec has not returned BTC/ETH strategy or Upbit paper runtime rows yet.
markets.cryptoNoRowsCopy: Core or exec has not returned crypto market/runtime rows yet.
markets.unavailableTitle: Market breadth feed is not connected yet
markets.unavailableCopy: The dashboard market snapshot is wired, but this standalone Markets route does not yet have a dedicated breadth or flow endpoint. Use factor screening or dashboard market condition while the live Markets feed remains pending.
markets.availableNowCopy: Use the wired surfaces below instead of fabricated market breadth.
markets.factorScreeningCopy: Rank momentum, low-risk, beta, value, and advanced-value families by market date.
markets.dashboardSnapshotCopy: Review the KOSPI/KOSDAQ, USD/KRW, and flow fields already shown on Dashboard.
markets.mySymbolsCopy: Open the tracked and favorite symbol workspace for quote coverage.
markets.trackedPreviewCopy: When a trading-core quote source is configured, tracked symbols can appear here as a secondary preview.
markets.noPreviewRows: No tracked quote preview rows are available.
markets.heroCopy: Cross-market monitoring is ready for spot, futures, and strategy routing. This area is now structured for real data from trading-core without redesigning the page shell.

bots.title: Bots
bots.description: A conservative scaffold for future bot read models, audit logs, and safety panels. It does not show bot state or capital allocation until those fields come from a real API.
bots.heroCopy: This route reserves the management space without fabricating operational state. Names, modes, controls, risk fields, and capital values stay hidden until trading-core exposes a verified read model.
bots.apiBackedRosterCopy: Bot names, modes, and status chips will render only after a real bot read model exists.
bots.auditTrailCopy: Command history and execution logs need confirmed source endpoints before display.
bots.safetyAnnotationsCopy: Risk and lock fields must come from explicit source fields, not placeholder copy.
